parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Relations to add to each entry: `user` adds the user who acted

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Text to search for in the entry's stored details (`meta`); entries that contain it are listed

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of entries in the page

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of entries to skip, newest first

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Only entries about this kind of object

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Only entries made by the user with this ID

200.description: One page of audit log entries, newest first, with the total count in the `X-Total-Count` header

X-Total-Count.description: Number of entries that match the filters, over all pages

description:
Lists the audit log, newest first, one page at a time. `limit` and `offset` page it and `X-Total-Count` holds the number of entries that match the filters. `query` searches the entry's stored details (`meta`), for example a host name. Add `expand=user` to include the user who acted. For a change made with an API token, `npmpro_api_token_id` and `npmpro_api_token_name` name the token. A 400 means an invalid filter value.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
